verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only ROCm/software ecosystem claims and generic product-page feature mentions (FSR, Anti-Lag, AV1, OS support); none of the items state the RX 9070 XT's actual VRAM capacity, memory type, bus width, or bandwidth. The '48GB VRAM' mention refers to workstation-class Radeon GPUs generally, not this specific part's spec sheet.
